question: Who propounded the theory of 'Advaita' in Hinduism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adi Sankaracharya**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The doctrine of Advaita or Monism was given by **Adi Sankaracharya**
 
• The philosophy of Advaita means ‘non-dualism, it means the soul is no different from Brahman.
 
• He used to say to people that “Atman is Brahman”.
 
• He started a Hindu revivalist movement in the ninth century to give a new orientation to Hinduism.
 
• He was born in Kaladi in Kerela.
 
• The doctrine of Advaita was too abstract to appeal to the common man.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
